# 0002-decision-drivers-structure.md

# Use Decision Drivers Structure

## Status

Accepted

## Decision Drivers

- We want to capture the forces that influence a decision
- Decision Drivers should be separate from the decision itself
- This allows traceability from forces to choices

## Considered Options

- Option A: No drivers section
- Option B: Decision Drivers section
- Option C: Context section only

## Decision Outcome

We will use a dedicated "Decision Drivers" section to capture the forces 
influencing each architectural decision, separate from the Decision Outcome.

## Consequences

- Better traceability
- Clearer separation of concerns
- More structured ADR format
